intervals.label: collaboration: antihydrogen production and measurement preparation
intervals.note: Start is the end-2022 antihydrogen run. End: 31 August 2026 (LS3).
intervals.quote: At the end of 2022, during an operation that lasted several days, the GBAR collaboration detected some 20 antihydrogen atoms produced in this way, validating this "in-flight" production method for the first time.

intervals.label: collaboration: Long Shutdown 3 (no antiproton beam)
intervals.note: The Antimatter Factory (AD and ELENA) delivered its last beams on 31 August 2026 and "will progressively return to operation from 2028 onwards, with the different injectors and facilities restarting in stages" (CERN, 31 August 2026); no experiment-specific restart date is published, so the end is left open.
intervals.quote: CERN’s injector complex and Antimatter Factory took their final steps towards Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) this morning, as the last particle beams were extracted and the machines fell silent.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists who run the GBAR experiment.
